label: Front-camera selfie
prompt_hint: A genuine arm-length front-camera selfie. The phone is outside the image; vary the location and angle from ordinary bedroom mirror shots.

label: Mirror selfie
prompt_hint: A physically correct mirror selfie with the phone visible only in the reflection. Use a setting and pose specific to her.

label: Timer portrait
prompt_hint: A phone or camera propped on a real surface using a timer, leaving both hands free and allowing a composition unlike a selfie.

label: Friend-taken portrait
prompt_hint: A flattering close or upper-body photograph taken by a friend in a place that belongs to her life; no phone in her hand.

label: Hobby photograph
prompt_hint: A face-readable photograph taken while doing or beside one real hobby or interest, with the activity visible without becoming a staged advertisement.

label: Work-life photograph
prompt_hint: A reusable photograph from her real work or working environment, while respecting uniforms, privacy and any hidden life.

label: Night-out photograph
prompt_hint: A face-readable photo someone else took during a real evening out, with social context and ambient light; no bedroom mirror.

label: Outdoor candid
prompt_hint: A selected candid-looking outdoor portrait taken by someone else, with a location tied to her routines and her face clearly readable.

label: Polished portrait
prompt_hint: A deliberately polished head-and-shoulders or upper-body portrait, professionally taken or made by a talented friend; no phone visible.

label: Over-the-shoulder portrait
prompt_hint: A photograph from behind as she turns partly back toward the camera, emphasizing her silhouette, hair and outfit; her face may be only partly visible.

label: Backlit silhouette
prompt_hint: A bold backlit silhouette against a real window, sunset, doorway or stage light. Her outline, hair and pose carry the image; facial detail may disappear completely.

label: Motion candid
prompt_hint: A selected candid of her moving—dancing, skating, running, turning or laughing—with intentional motion blur and an energetic composition rather than a static pose.

label: Window reflection
prompt_hint: Her reflection in a train, café or nighttime window, layered with real lights or scenery beyond the glass. The reflection may obscure part of her face but must remain deliberately composed.

label: Fragmented reflection
prompt_hint: An artful reflection split across a small hand mirror, mirrored tiles or several reflective surfaces. Show one coherent woman, not duplicated bodies; partial facial fragments are allowed.

label: Instant-film snapshot
prompt_hint: A scanned instant-film photograph with a physical white border, direct flash, imperfect exposure and a specific real moment rather than a modern phone-selfie aesthetic.

label: Photo-booth frame
prompt_hint: One frame or a clearly composed strip from an old photo booth: direct frontal flash, cramped curtain backdrop and a spontaneous expression or pose she would actually choose.

label: Overhead reclining portrait
prompt_hint: A physically plausible timer or friend-taken photograph looking down while she lies on a bed, rug, grass or another place belonging to her, with hair, clothes and nearby objects shaping the frame.

label: Environmental wide shot
prompt_hint: A wider photograph where her full figure and a meaningful environment share attention. Her face may be small; occupation, hobby, scale, style or location should make the image unmistakably hers.

label: Face hidden by a prop
prompt_hint: A playful deliberate portrait where a real object tied to her—book, flowers, helmet, camera, record sleeve or fan—hides most or all of her face while her hair, body, clothes and setting carry identity.

label: Patterned-shadow portrait
prompt_hint: A portrait shaped by real patterned light from blinds, leaves, lace, water or architecture. Shadow may cross or partly conceal her face instead of keeping it evenly lit.

label: Helmet or mask portrait
prompt_hint: A contextually justified helmet, visor or adult fashion mask obscures her face while the rest of the photograph establishes who she is. Use only gear supported by her work, hobby, style or species—not a random costume.

label: Identity-through-detail
prompt_hint: A deliberately face-free crop centered on one visually distinctive, non-explicit part of her identity: hands at work, characteristic hair from behind, an outfit silhouette, shoulders, legs or a meaningful object she is holding.

label: Waterline portrait
prompt_hint: A pool, bath, lake or shoreline portrait shot at water level or just below the surface, with physically believable refraction, wet hair and available light. Her face may be distorted or partly submerged.

label: Security-camera still
prompt_hint: A knowingly chosen, plausible security-camera or doorbell-camera still connected to her work, home or sense of humour: wide fixed angle, timestamp-like framing without requiring legible text, imperfect exposure, and no handheld phone pose.
